literal: modesty called even one thing we do not know, by passion he who cares pleasingly if does.
translation: I know nothing of a thing called modesty when my lover, out of passion, does exactly what pleases me.
modern: காதலர் தன் காமத்தால் நான் விரும்பும் செயல்களைச் செய்தால், நாணம் என்று சொல்லப்படும் ஒரு பொருளை நான் அறிய மாட்டேன்.
explanation: The heroine expresses how her deep love overcomes her natural sense of reserve. She states that if her lover acts out of passion to do exactly what pleases her ('பெட்ப செயின்'), she completely loses herself. In those moments, she does not even recognize a concept called modesty ('நாண் என ஒன்றோ அறியலம்'). The word 'பேணியார்' refers to the lover who cares for her, highlighting that his affectionate actions dissolve her inhibitions.
